messages:
maya: Quick check — planning to deploy the client telemetry opt-in gate (API v2.0 flag) tomorrow 2026-03-18 09:30 PDT. Rollout plan: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~3h. Need owners for deploy, smoke, rollback. Who can take the 09:30 trigger?
kevin: I can trigger and watch the rollout, will be on pager. I’ll own 09:30.
toni: I’ll run the smoke checklist and watch service logs. Put me down as smoke owner.
sam: We need client comms queued 30m before canary (email + in-app). @maya can you confirm the message and who sends?
maya: Yes, I’ll publish the short notice and coordinate support. Draft will go to #release-notify and support 30m prior.
maya: Adding the smoke script we'll use:
```
./scripts/smoke_client_telemetry.sh --env prod --fast
# checks: header-preserve, sampling-flag, quick client regression
```
deploy-bot: rollout scheduled by maya: env=prod, start=2026-03-18T16:30:00Z, buckets=[canary:10, staged:50, global:100], rollback_hook=/ops/rollback-telemetry.sh
kevin: On deploy I'll run `kubectl rollout status` and tail gateway logs. Threshold: if client error rate >5% sustained for 5m or spike in 5xx then rollback.
toni: Smoke checklist (fast):
- verify client headers are unchanged
- confirm sampling flag toggles in trace-service
- run `yarn test:clients:quick`
- check p50/p95 latency no reg >60ms
- confirm telemetry producers don't spike error rates

maya: Client comms draft link: https://go/release/telemetry-opt-in-draft — short subject + CTA + opt-out URL. Sam will send via the release pipeline.
sam: I'll queue the notification to go 30m before start. Also putting a support playbook in #support.
kevin: Rollback procedure (ops): run `/ops/rollback-telemetry.sh --reason "client-errors"` from jumpbox, revert flag in feature-gate service, and redeploy previous gateway revision.
toni: If rollback happens I’ll open an incident ticket and attach the smoke run logs. I’ll also collect traces and slow queries.
maya: Ownership summary: Kevin = deploy, Toni = smoke/logs, Ryan = on-call SRE, Sam = comms, Maya = PM/coord. Ryan — can you be available 10m before deploy?
ryan: Yep, I’ll join the thread and the call. Ping me when canary hits 10%.
kevin: Quick preflight I'll run at T-1h: config diff, canary bucket sanity, run smoke script locally against staging.
kevin: Command I'll use for canary check: `kubectl -n gateway exec -c health gateway-0 -- curl -f http://localhost/health`

toni: :thumbsup:
kevin: :rocket:

maya: Final note — if anyone spots a breaking client change during canary (header renames, missing fields) call rollback immediately. Postmortem owner if rollback: maya (PM) + kevin (eng) + toni (SRE).
sam: I’ll also prepare a short customer-facing FAQ in case we need it.
maya: Thanks everyone — I’ll post the final checklist in #eng-platform 1h before and update the calendar invite.
